summary_1line: Rama recounts how King Nriga, cursed by two brahmins over a disputed cow, abdicates and accepts years of suffering in a ditch awaiting future liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Two furious brahmin sages stand before King Nriga and pronounce a terrible curse that he will become a lizard and dwell unseen in a ditch for ages.
King Nriga calmly installs his son Vasu on the throne before ministers and citizens, announcing his acceptance of the curse.
The king descends into a deep, gem-adorned ditch surrounded by flowering trees and fragrant blossoms to begin his long expiation.
